tei:div.tei:p: #!"# ༄༅// mgon po tshogs bdag gi sngags 'grigs bai ro tsa nas ldi ri chos grags la gnang ba bzhugs so//

oṃ shrī ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ ma hā kā la sid+dhi yaṃ du dza dzaḥ nye snying*/ rlung ltar myur ba'i snying pa'o// oṃ shrī ma hā kā la gu ṇa hṛ da hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshogs bdag ltar bsnyen pa'i snying po'o// oṃ badz+ra yak+sha bai ta li hūm̐/ yum bsnyen tshag bar dgu ma'o// oṃ badz+ra yak+sha bai ta li hūm̐ phaṭa dza dzaḥ yum bsnyen tshag bar bcu gnyis pa'o// oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ga ṇa pa ti shaṃ ka ri sid+dhi hūm̐ phaṭa/ ci 'dod dngos grub 'byung*/ oṃ ma hā kā la yak+ṣa bai ta li hūm̐ phaṭa/ yab yum gnyis med/ oṃ ma hā kā la ār+ya re man+ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ shar phyogs mgon po/ oṃ ma hā kā la tad shad dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ lho/ oṃ ma hā kā la me tri ma ru ke ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub/ oṃ ma hā kā la bai shra ma ṇa ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang*/ oṃ ma hā kā la ār+ya dzam+bha la hūm̐ phaṭa/ shar lho/ oṃ ma hā kā la de ba niḥṛ ti hūm̐ phaṭa/ lho nub/ oṃ ma hā kā la ru gho ru gha ni ru ghe hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub byang*/ oṃ ma hā kā la ī sha na ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang shar/ oṃ ma hā kā la tsan+d+ra ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ steng*/ oṃ ma hā kā la a dhi pa ti bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'og / oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdud mgon/ oṃ badz+ra re ma ti ma bh+yo dzaḥ re ma ti/ oṃ ma hā kā la aḥde ba rak+sha hūm̐ phaṭa/ lha/ oṃ ma hā kā la yaḥya ma rak+sha hūm̐ phaṭa/ gshin rje/ oṃ ma hā kā la maḥm ma rak+sha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ma mo/ oṃ ma hā kā la duḥpra ma rak+sha hūm̐ phaṭa/ bdud/ oṃ ma hā kā la ruḥ.a shwa rak+sha hūm̐ phaṭa/ btsan/ oṃ ma hā kā la tsaḥrā dza rak+sha hūm̐ phaṭa/ rgyal po/ oṃ ma hā kā la shaḥyak+sha rak+sha hūm̐ phaṭa/ gnod sbyin/ oṃ ma hā kā la naḥnā ga rak+sha hūm̐ phaṭa/ klu/ hūm̐ bh+yo aḥyaḥmaḥduḥruḥtsaḥshaḥnaḥs ma ya dza dzaḥ ma mgon sde brgyad bsdus pa/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa gtum po/ ma hā chen po/

kā la ya nag po/ shā sa na bstan pa la/ u pa hā ri ṇi/ nye bar 'tshe ba/ e ṣa a 'di pa/ pash+tsi ma kā lo a yaṃ phyi ma'i dus/ i daṃ da yang 'dir/ rat+na tra yā ya dkon mchog rin chen gsum la/ a pa kā ri ṇa/ gnod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs rnams/ ya ti pra ti dz+nyā gal te na/ sma ra si ta dā dran par gyis la/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭāṃ che ge mo gdug pa can 'di/ kha kha zo zo/ khā hi khā hi/ zo zhig zo zhig / mā ra mā ra/ sod sod/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ zungs zungs/ ban+dha ban+dha/ chings chings/ ha na ha na/ snun snun/ da ha da ha/ sregs sregs/ pa tsa pa tsa/ tshos tshos/ di na me ke na mā ra ya nyi ma gcig gis gsad par mdzod cig/che ge mo hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ thun sngags/ chos skyong spyi ltar bsnyen pa'o// oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ga ṇa gu ti ka ma la shrī nag mo ti la bh+yo/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la be sha tra ma thums nan/ gser srang bcu drug gi gdams pa'o// oṃ shrī ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā la sid+dhi yaṃ du dza dzaḥ yab kyi 'bod pa'o// oṃ badz+ra yak+sha bai ta li hūm̐ dza dzaḥ yum gyi 'bod pa'o// oṃ ma hā kā la ya dgra bo'i snying la 'byin/ snying la su tri dgra bo'i tsit+ta rbad/ yab kyi rbad pa'o// oṃ ma hā kā la nṛ thums luṃ thums ril rbad su nṛ dzaḥ dgra bo'i snying la mā ra ya rbad/ yab kyi gsad pa'o// oṃ badz+ra yak+sha bai ta li hūm̐/ trag rak+sha rak+mo thums ling*/ snying la 'dus 'dus srog la bring bring shaṃ shaṃ khyer bh+yo/ yum gyi rbad pa'o// trag rak+sha rak+mo thums ril rbad/ snying kha la rak+sha dza dzaḥ trag rak+sha tsit+ta shaṃ long*/ snying kha la rak+sha dza dzaḥ thums ling ri li li bh+yo/ ma mo'i gsad pa'o// oṃ shrī ma hā kā la gu ṇa hṛ da kā ya wā ka tsit+ta dgra bgegs sarba sha trūṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ thun sngags so// rdzogs so/// /
